register.description: The FW Region 3 End Address Low Register defines the end address bits 31 to 0 to include for the target br_SCRP_32_HSM_CLK1_to_SCRP_32_HSM_CLK2_l0 region 3 firewall.

bitfield.description: End address bits 31 to 12 to include in the match. Lowest 12 bits are forced to 1s as address must be 4KB aligned. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
End address bits 11 to 0 are forced to 1s as address must be 4KB aligned minus 1. Reset Source: domain_default_rst_mod_g_rst_n
